stem.en: Eight craftspeople start a cooperative in which, as at Lijjat, profits are shared equally. In its first month the cooperative makes a profit of ₹24,000 after paying all its costs. How many rupees does each member get? These are made-up numbers.

explanation.en: The profit is shared equally among 8 members: ₹24,000 ÷ 8 = ₹3,000 each.
